name: process-foundry
description: Turn source evidence into validated ProcessIR and deterministic, editable BPMN 2.0.

scripts.build: react-router build && npm run bundle:sanitize && npm run bundle:check
scripts.build:production: CLOUDFLARE_ENV=production BUNDLE_CHECK_SKIP_LOCAL_SECRET_SOURCES=1 npm run build && npm run release:verify
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run public-copy:check && npm run lint && npm run typegen:check && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:e2e && npm run build
scripts.db:migrate:production: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --env production --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy:dry-run:production: npm run build:production && CLOUDFLARE_ENV=production wrangler deploy --dry-run
scripts.deploy:production: test -n "$BPMN_BUILDER_PRODUCTION_SECRETS" && test -f "$BPMN_BUILDER_PRODUCTION_SECRETS" && test -s "$BPMN_BUILDER_PRODUCTION_SECRETS" && node scripts/assert-deploy-ready-config.mjs --secrets-file "$BPMN_BUILDER_PRODUCTION_SECRETS" && npm run build:production && CLOUDFLARE_ENV=production wrangler deploy --strict --env production --config wrangler.jsonc --secrets-file "$BPMN_BUILDER_PRODUCTION_SECRETS"
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.typegen:production: mkdir -p .wrangler/types && wrangler types .wrangler/types/worker-configuration.production.d.ts --env production --config wrangler.jsonc && react-router typegen
